title: simple cannons
description: adds basic cannons that can be placed in the world and shoot fireballs
body:
adds 1 new item, the cannon

the cannon can be crafted with 2 logs of any kind, 1 barrel, 1 iron ingot and 3 smooth stones
(the recipe is automatically unlocked after the datapack is added)
![crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b70eca278a4386c6befad5d071b4a01f9f42a86b_0.webp)
rmb to deploy the cannon
![3 cannons after being deployed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/287440411e67f472f5dc0de0ead1ed7f749166a1_0.webp)
after the cannon is placed you can press:

rmb to spawn a fireball
![cannon shooting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/703effaf6c0ffdf1ad87a91f31c65b6a9ae82b91_0.webp)
lmb to destroy the cannon, the cannon will be dropped in item form after
![destroyed cannon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d16c85fbefc60d0d6fad7379a0a531b7f792bc0_0.webp)
